title: Onion rings
method: In a medium bowl, combine flour, milk, salt, paprika, and cayenne to make onion ring batter.
Remove inner rings of onion slices and discard. Take the large rings and dip in batter.
Place battered rings in hot oil. When they begin to rise to the top of the oil and become golden brown, turn over and continue to cook for 2 minutes.
Remove onions rings from oil with sieve and drain on paper towels. Serve onion rings immediately.
